build_mae_vit_model: build a MAEViTEVA02 Vision Transformer model for masked autoencoder pre-training with configurable mask ratio
init_weights_sincos: initialize the MAEViTEVA02 model weights with 2D sine-cosine position embeddings and Xavier uniform patch projection
random_masking_patches: apply random patch masking to input tensor keeping a subset of patches for MAE pre-training
forward_masked_features: run forward pass on images with random masking to extract hidden features for visible patches
forward_unmasked_features: run forward pass on images without masking to extract features using the parent ViTEVA02 model
